name: Janaka Wickramarachchi
text:
I recently stopped at Heritage Family Restaurant, and it turned out to be one of the best dining experiences I've had while traveling along the Yatiyantota–Kitulgala Road. Restaurant with a nice view of Kitulgala river.

What makes this place truly special is that it's a small, family-run restaurant where you can genuinely feel the care and dedication that goes into everything they do. The owners and staff were incredibly warm, welcoming, and attentive, making us feel at home from the moment we arrived. Despite the restaurant being busy, the service was impressively quick and well organized.

The food was outstanding. Every dish we ordered was freshly prepared, full of authentic flavors, and served hot. You can immediately tell that they use fresh ingredients, and the quality of the food is far better than what you'd expect for the price. The portions were generous, and the menu offers excellent value for money, making it an affordable option for families, groups, and travelers alike.

The restaurant itself has a clean and pleasant atmosphere, making it a comfortable place to relax and enjoy a meal before continuing your journey.

If you're driving between Yatiyantota and Kitulgala, I highly recommend making a stop at Heritage Family Restaurant. Whether you're looking for breakfast, lunch, or dinner, you'll be treated to delicious food, excellent service, and genuine Sri Lankan hospitality. It's always a pleasure to support hardworking local family businesses like this, and I will definitely be visiting again whenever I'm in the area. Highly recommended!

name: Jérome BRH
text:
Après plusieurs heures de route vers Adam’s Peak, nous nous sommes arrêté en plein après midi pour déjeuner. Nous avons été très bien reçu, toujours avec le sourire ! Le petit restaurant en bord de route cache bien son jeu, il offre une vu surplombant la rivière très agréable et une nourriture local de qualité!
Après discussion il propose aussi un hébergement type maison dans les arbres qui nous paraît également être une bonne option pour ceux qui souhaitent faire le trajet en deux étapes ou pour profiter du lieu.
textTranslated: After several hours' drive to Adam's Peak, we stopped in the middle of the afternoon for lunch. We received a very warm welcome, always with a smile! The small roadside restaurant is surprisingly charming, offering a lovely view overlooking the river and excellent local food! After chatting, we learned they also offer treehouse accommodation, which seemed like a good option for those who want to break up the drive into two stages or simply enjoy the area.
responseFromOwnerText: Thank you very much 🙏 for your review... If you come back to Sri Lanka come visit our place... ❤
